[TK] Safety in Dry Dock.question: Why do you think this accident happened? Select the statement that you think best describes the cause of this accident.
options: The crewmember was not paying attention when he was walking.
There were unexpected obstacles in the crewmember's way.
The crewmember was carrying too large a load.
The crewmember was wearing inappropriate footwear.
[TK] Safety in Dry Dock.answer: There were unexpected obstacles in the crewmember's way.

[TK] Safety in Dry Dock.question: Safety is the first priority when your vessel is in dry dock, just as it is when it's at sea! And yet, these two environments are very different! While you are still responsible for your own safety, who do you think has overall responsibility or authority for your safety while in dry dock- the Master or the Shipyard? Make your selection by selecting the appropriate hot spot.
